text: The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) refused to authorise the holding of the demonstration of 31 July 2010 at the places indicated by the organisers.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) proposed three alternative locations on the outskirts of Baku for the 31 July 2010 demonstration: a stadium in the Binagadi District, a square in the proximity of Zigh road in the Khatai District, and a yard of a driving school situated in the 20th residential area of the Sabail District.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) noted that the squares in one of which the organisers proposed to hold the 31 July 2010 assembly were designated for public leisure.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) noted that the other places proposed by the organisers for the 31 July 2010 demonstration were areas with heavy traffic.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: For both the 2 April 2011 and 17 April 2011 demonstrations, the Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) proposed a different location on the outskirts of Baku, namely the yard of a driving school situated in the 20th residential area of the Sabail District.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) noted that the places proposed by the organisers for the 2 April 2011 and 17 April 2011 demonstrations were areas with heavy traffic.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The organisers decided to hold the demonstrations in the centre of Baku, notwithstanding the Baku City Executive Authority's refusals to authorise the proposed locations.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On the day of the applicants' arrests, administrative offence reports (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) were issued in respect of each of the applicants.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The administrative offence reports stated that by deliberately failing to comply with lawful police orders, the applicants had committed an administrative offence under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Some of the applicants refused to sign the respective administrative offence reports.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to most of the applicants in applications nos. 57737/11, 67351/11, 67977/11, 69411/11 and 69421/11, they were never served with other documents in their case files.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the applicant in application no. 57737/11, he obtained a copy of the administrative offence report several months after the administrative proceedings against him had ended.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the time of the applicants' arrests, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences of 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative offence proceedings has the right to a copy of the administrative offence report.
section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the time of the applicants' arrests, Article 437.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences of 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision in an administrative offence case shall be given to the individual with respect to whom the decision was adopted within three days of its adoption.
section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the time of the applicants' arrests, Article 437.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences of 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision sentencing an individual to administrative detention shall be given to that individual on the day of its adoption.
